summary:
This bill is a joint resolution. A joint resolution is a type of bill that must be approved by both the Senate and the House of Representatives, and then signed by the President, to become a law. 

This bill wants to end a specific national emergency. A national emergency is a special announcement made by the President that gives the government extra powers to handle a big problem. 

In this case, the President declared a national emergency on July 30, 2025, in a document called Executive Order 14323. The government used this emergency to put duties on items brought into the United States from the country of Brazil. Duties are extra taxes that people must pay when they bring goods from another country into the United States. 

If this bill becomes law, that national emergency will end. This means the extra taxes on goods imported from Brazil would stop.
